question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Inquisitive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Uninterested.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inquisitive"** means having or showing an interest in learning things; curious. (जिज्ञासु)

 
 
• **Example:** The inquisitive child asked many questions about the world around her.
 
 
 
• **"Uninterested"** refers to having or showing no feeling of interest; indifferent. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** She was uninterested in the conversation and kept looking at her phone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Inquisitive'** is **'Uninterested'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Uninterested**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dull** (नीरस): Lacking interest or excitement.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that many students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **Indolent** (आलसी): Wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy.
 
 
• **Example:** His indolent attitude towards work made him very unproductive.
 
 
 
• **Curious** (जिज्ञासु): Eager to know or learn something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was curious about the new technology and wanted to learn more about it.
 
 

Note: This is a PYP question, and the official answer key has marked (correct option) as the correct answer, hence we cannot make any changes to it.
